span.label: mechanism
span.quote: The results of both experiments support a retrieval model involving a dependence between separate successive decisions about whether each of the two strings is a word

span.label: associative priming in lexical decision
span.quote: The results of Exp, I suggest that degree of association is a powerful factor affecting lexical decisions in the yes-no task

span.label: behavioural-experiment
span.quote: Two experiments are reported in which 5s were presented two strings of letters simultaneously, with one string displayed visually above the other

span.label: The data cannot decide between the spreading-excitation and location-shifting accounts of the dependence.
span.quote: The present data do not provide a direct test between this location-shifting model and the spreading-excitation model

span.label: The authors have no way to test all candidate explanations of the association effect.
span.quote: At present we do not have ways to test all the possible explanations of these effects

span.label: Experiment II's reaction times cannot directly test the serial-decision model.
span.quote: The RTs from the same-different task do not provide direct evidence for testing the proposed serial-decision model because both lexical decisions are assumed to be made before all same-different responses
